properties.displayName: Guarded Advisor: Cognitive Services accounts must have local (key) authentication disabled
properties.description: Learning exercise (D-017): the built-in 'Azure AI Services resources should have key access disabled (disable local authentication)' (71ef260a) already denies this and also covers AI Search, so the lab assigns the built-in and keeps this definition unassigned. Denies a Cognitive Services account unless disableLocalAuth is true; a missing value is also denied.
